entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while I connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David, agent ID 304. How can I help you with your VeloFit products today?
Yeah, hi. I need to return this VeloBand GPS Tracker. It's just not for me.
I can certainly look into that for you. To start, could you please provide me with your order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
It's angrycustomer@email.com. Just process the return, I don't have all day.
Thank you. Pulling that up now... I see the VeloBand Pulse, ordered on December 15th. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It doesn't matter why! I bought it, I don't want it, and I want my money back. Your website says you have a return policy.
I understand you'd like a return, sir. I've reviewed your order details, and I see the VeloBand Pulse was delivered 25 days ago.
And? So what? Get on with it.
Well sir, our return policy for the new VeloBand Pulse is 10 days from the date of delivery. Because it has been 25 days, I'm afraid it is too late to start a return for this item.
WHAT?! Ten days? That's insane! It's practically brand new. This is a complete scam! I want to speak to your manager right now.
I can appreciate your frustration, but this specific policy is in place for all wearable electronics for health and safety reasons. After this amount of time, we can't accept it back.
I don't care about your reasons! This is unacceptable customer service! I will leave a one-star review on every website I can find. Get me a manager!

A manager will provide you with the same information, sir. The policy is firm. Due to the personal nature of the device being worn on the skin, for hygiene reasons, we cannot process a return after the 10-day window has passed.
Hygiene? I barely wore it! This is just an excuse to steal my money. What kind of company has a 10-day policy? It's predatory!

It's a strict sanitation measure, sir, to ensure the safety of our products and staff. The 10-day return window is listed on the product page for the VeloBand Pulse. As it is now far beyond that timeframe, it is unfortunately too late. My hands are tied by the system and our safety policy.
Unbelievable. You've just lost a customer for life, and I'm going to make sure everyone I know hears about this. This is ridiculous. I'm filing a chargeback.
I am sorry we couldn't reach a resolution you were happy with. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No! You haven't assisted me at all! *click*
